He begins a journey where he hopes to find his tormentor, to find an answer and perhaps to ultimately find redemption.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When an innocent man is brutally attacked and beaten to death by what looks like a monster in a black cape, the CSIs are called to investigate, only to learn that a similar attack took place minutes later.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When a dead woman is found hanging from a cross inside a church, the team follows the evidence to uncover a bizarre love triangle dating all the way back to the victim's high school days.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When two young boys are reported missing, a known neighborhood sex offender is the primary suspect.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: While investigating an elderly woman's murder, Grissom receives a miniature crime scene replica; Greg attends a hearing to ascertain his culpability in a teenager's accidental death.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When identical twins are found dead, the evidence in both cases does not immediately prove a connection between the two deaths. However, as the CSIs dig deeper into the histories of the women, a surprising twist takes the investigation in a new direction.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom and his team investigate a string of murders in Las Vegas that may be tied to an infamous mob boss from the 1970s who disappeared many years ago.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: When the CSIs process clues after a murder at a poultry manufacturing plant, the evidence leads them to the home of a man who collects miniature trains and other miniature paraphernalia.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Catherine's testimony in court is not enough to convict a killer suspected of murdering his own mother. Adam Novak, with whom Catherine had a brief romantic encounter, is the lawyer who represents the killer and secures his freedom.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: The lead suspect for the high-profile murder of anti-drug crusading assemblyman Danilo Zamesca is Thomas Simon, the west coast's biggest drug supplier.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: As Catherine and Keppler begin to investigate the murder of a teen-aged Jane Doe, both agree that the killer, who was meticulous in removing evidence from the body and its surrounding area, is likely a repeat offender.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: A case involving a man's torched corpse whose bones and tissues had been harvested leads Nick and Keppler into the disturbing world of illegally sold human body parts.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom returns from his teaching sabbatical as new member of the team, Michael Keppler desperately tries to keep his dark past hidden from his colleagues.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: With potentially less than a day to attempt to prevent the next murders, the CSI team must quickly shake off their shock that the true miniature killer is not the late Ernie Edward Dell, who committed suicide after confessing to the slayings.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Grissom's quip that two missing young lovers may have run off to Mexico is soon quashed by the discovery of drops of blood by the boy's vacant parking spot at the high school.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: While processing the house where several showgirls were murdered, Sara is haunted by the terrified eyes and cryptic dying words of the sixth victim she discovers.

programme.title: CSI
programme.desc: Greg is forced to again contend with the hostile mother and brother of the hoodlum he killed in self-defense several months ago when the CSI team discovers that the brother is involved in a new murder case.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Catherine investigan la aparición de una pierna cortada de un cuerpo en un lago. Mientras tanto, Sara y Nick investigan un juramento de fraternidad que ha salido terriblemente mal.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Warrick toman el caso de un joven que es descubierto desnudo en el desierto sin una causa obvia de muerte.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Catherine viola el protocolo del departamento cuando acepta el caso de una acusación de violación contra su exmarido. Warrick y Sara buscan la bala perdida que exonerará o acusará a un policía de asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Cuando una adolescente y su hermana son las únicas supervivientes del espantoso asesinato de cuatro miembros de una familia en un tranquilo barrio suburbano, Grissom y todo su equipo investigan el crimen.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Royce Harmon fue asesinado hace 3 meses en una escena montada para que pareciera un suicidio. Ahora se ha producido otro asesinato.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y su equipo investigan la muerte de un pasajero de primera clase en un vuelo a Las Vegas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Grissom y Sara investigan un cuerpo plagado de bichos encontrado en el desierto. Warrick y Catherine investigan el robo de unas valiosas obras de arte.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una mujer es secuestrada en un supermercado. En la tienda, Grissom encuentra la puerta de un baño que dice que cinco mujeres han sido asesinadas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Un preso condenado a muerte manda un video pidiendo ayuda a Gil, afirmando que es inocente de la muerte de su mujer y su hijo, Gill acepta el caso y con la ayuda de Sara y de Warrick intenta averiguar lo que de verdad sucedió en la casa.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una bomba explota en un edificio de oficinas matando a una persona e hiriendo a muchas más. El principal sospechoso es un guardia de seguridad que se marchó minutos antes de la explosión y que tiene conocimiento en la fabricación de bombas.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Cuando se descubre un único hueso humano en el desierto, Grissom y Catherine deben recorrer kilómetros de territorio para encontrar el resto del esqueleto.
programme.sub-title: Reducir a la mitad y mantener

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: En una elegante recaudación de fondos, a la que asiste el sheriff, una mujer aparece muerta en la piscina.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una mujer es secuestrada en el aparcamiento de un centro comercial. Es violada, golpeada, disparada y dada por muerta. Sara recoge pruebas de ella y se encariña con ella.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Encuentran un cadáver en una tienda de cerámica en lo que parece ser un robo interrumpido.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Una pareja que sale de un restaurante en su aniversario es asesinada en la calle y su coche es robado. La escena del crimen se ve comprometida cuando llueve poco después de que lleguen los CSI.

programme.title: CSI en español
programme.desc: Todo el equipo investiga el secuestro del hijo pequeño de una familia acomodada. Las sospechas recaen inmediatamente sobre los padres del niño.

programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: Terminator: Destino oculto
programme.desc: Un súper soldado mejorado se une a la combatiente Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) y un aliado inesperado (Arnold Schwarzenegger) para detener al Terminator más mortífero hasta el momento.

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Jason Momoa protagoniza este intenso thriller de acción sobre un leñador que lucha por sobrevivir contra los traficantes de drogas que han escondido heroína en su cabaña de caza.

programme.title: 12 Rounds 3: atrapado
programme.desc: La superestrella de WWE, Dean Ambrose, interpreta a Shaw, un detective que vuelve a su trabajo después de la muerte de su compañero. Cuando descubre evidencia que involucra a sus compañeros policías con una muerte.

programme.title: 13 ASESINOS
programme.desc: Un ingenuo joven adopta la identidad de un hombre muerto para unirse a un juego de mafiosos de ruleta rusa. Con Mickey Rourke, Jason Statham y Michael Shannon.

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña
programme.desc: Jason Momoa protagoniza este intenso thriller de acción sobre un leñador que lucha por sobrevivir contra los traficantes de drogas que han escondido heroína en su cabaña de caza.

programme.title: Terminator: Destino oculto
programme.desc: Un súper soldado mejorado se une a la combatiente Sarah Connor (Linda Hamilton) y un aliado inesperado (Arnold Schwarzenegger) para detener al Terminator más mortífero hasta el momento.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), un agente secreto, es incriminado por la muerte de su compañero de espionaje e intenta deshacerse de los asesinos del gobierno que lo persiguen. Corre contra el reloj mientras intenta descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Pequeñas grandes amigas
programme.desc: Molly es una princesa fiestera, con dinero que acaba de agotarse. Ray es una niña quisquillosa, quien acaba de sacar la niñera huyendo. Cuando Molly es contratada para cuidar de Ray, las chicas deben de cambiar sus vidas.

programme.title: Cartas a Julieta
programme.desc: Mientras está de vacaciones en Verona, Sophie se encuentra con una carta a Julieta y se embarca en una misión para encontrar a su autor.

programme.title: Fuerzas de la naturaleza
programme.desc: Ben está intentando llegar a Savannah para su boda. Una gaviota vuela hacia el motor de su avión cuando está despegando. Todos los vuelos más tarde se cancelan por un huracán, entonces hace dedo y lo lleva una atractiva mujer llamada Sara.

programme.title: Novia a la fuga
programme.desc: Roberts y Gere confirman su condición de eterno equipo de pantalla en esta encantadora comedia romántica llena de risas.

programme.title: Chicas pesadas
programme.desc: Tras vivir en África, Cady descubre lo salvaje que puede ser la civilización al enfrentarse a la reina del colegio: la fría y popular Regina George.

programme.title: Fuerzas de la naturaleza
programme.desc: Ben está intentando llegar a Savannah para su boda. Una gaviota vuela hacia el motor de su avión cuando está despegando. Todos los vuelos más tarde se cancelan por un huracán, entonces hace dedo y lo lleva una atractiva mujer llamada Sara.

programme.title: Novia a la fuga
programme.desc: Roberts y Gere confirman su condición de eterno equipo de pantalla en esta encantadora comedia romántica llena de risas.

programme.title: Plan B
programme.desc: Jennifer López interpreta a una soltera que se enamora del hombre perfecto justo cuando decide ser madre en esta comedia romántica de éxito sobre el noviazgo, el amor, el matrimonio y la paternidad, pero no necesariamente en ese orden.

programme.title: Pena de muerte
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar, Susan Sarandon interpreta a la hermana Helen Prejean. Una mujer espiritual quien se embarca en la peligrosa misión de salvar a un joven condenado a la pena de muerte.

programme.title: Alto impacto
programme.desc: Ganadora de 3 Premios Óscar, incluida Mejor Película, un accidente une a varios desconocidos en Los Ángeles.

programme.title: Tierra de sueños
programme.desc: Un joven se encuentra en un dilema, cuando descubre a una ladrona de bancos escondiéndose en su pequeña aldea; entre reclamar la recompensa por su cabeza y su creciente atracción por la seductora delincuente.

programme.title: Reds
programme.desc: El periodista estadounidense John Reed (Warren Beatty) y su esposa Louise Bryant (Diane Keaton) son testigos de la Revolución Rusa.

programme.title: Los intocables
programme.desc: El clásico enfrentamiento entre el bien y el mal, con Kevin Costner como el agente federal Eliot Ness, Robert De Niro como el jefe mafioso Al Capone y Sean Connery como Malone.

programme.title: El matador
programme.desc: Un asesino a sueldo que recorre el mundo entabla una inesperada amistad con un vendedor tras encontrarse en un bar de hotel en la Ciudad de México.

programme.title: Cuatro hermanos
programme.desc: Unos hermanos muy diferentes entre sí (Mark Wahlberg, Tyrese Gibson, André Benjamin) se reúnen para vengarse tras enterarse del asesinato de su madre adoptiva.

programme.title: Cine Romántico
programme.desc: Cine Romántico warms your heart with stories full of love, joy, emotion and laughter. Escape to romance with the best in Hollywood TV movies selected especially for you, all in Spanish.

programme.title: Working Miracles
programme.desc: Después de recuperarse de un accidente, Buddy descubre que posee un extraordinario poder curativo.

programme.title: The Right Girl
programme.desc: Una niña rica y consentida pierde su fortuna y se ve obligada a tomar un empleo en el mundo real.

programme.title: Always A Bride
programme.desc: En Las Vegas, una novia despierta casada a un hombre distinto.

programme.title: Undercover Angel
programme.desc: Una chica ayuda al exnovio de su madre a encontrar el amor.

programme.title: Love's Long Journey
programme.desc: Una pareja de recién casados enfrenta dificultades en su nueva vida.

programme.title: The Long Shot
programme.desc: Abandonada por su esposo, sin un lugar donde vivir y sin dinero, ella consigue empleo en un establo.

programme.title: Generation Gap
programme.desc: Un adolescente (Alex Black) con problemas pasa el verano con su abuelo.

programme.title: The Wedding Do Over
programme.desc: Una planificadora de bodas llamada Abby se especializa en arreglar las bodas que les han ido mal.

programme.title: Annie's Point

programme.title: The Hungover Games

programme.title: Spy Cat
programme.desc: Four crazy anti-heroes, one pawsome adventure. Join special-agent Marnie and her friends as they team up and fight crime. programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy Lupin manages to convince the pack elders to let him sit Howlington Academy’s entrance test. Freddy must use all his poodle wits- and his best friend Batty’s help!- to win a place at the historically wolf-only academy.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s the first day of school, and Freddy immediately comes into conflict with bully Ivan, who blackmails him into stealing the sacred moonstone! But when Batty is exposed to the moonstone, she’s turned into a human girl!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy attempts to teach Batty how to be human, while searching for a cure for her new form. A class assignment to capture the mysterious ‘Golden Horn’ and prove who the ‘alpha’ wolf is goes awry when a wilderwolf attacks!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: Freddy becomes convinced that there’s a wilderwolf at Howlington, and launches a daring investigation to prove that it’s the school accountant, Mr Sminch. Howlington gets a new teacher, the super cool and charming Ric Rawls.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids are struck down by a flea infestation, and Freddy and Batty are tasked with tracking down the mysterious Doog, keeper of the Fleaminator, the most powerful flea treatment known to dog, before they’re all expelled!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: The kids head out on their first excursion to Night Patrol HQ. Freddy gets pulled into Scarlet’s world as she gets closer to the truth about werewolves and the two bond when they get stuck in the forest while tracking a wolf.

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone
programme.desc: It’s Howloween, and Howlington is on lockdown. But when the students stage a play that goes wrong and the lockdown is disrupted, it will be up to the kids to save the grown-ups from themselves - including Principal Pincus!

programme.title: 100% Wolf : Legend of the Moonstone

programme.title: Back to the Sea
programme.desc: When little fish Kevin is swept up in a net and taken from his home in the vast oceans to the small glass fish tank of a restaurant, he must find a way to escape and make his way back home.

Agustín chantajea a Magdalena con la tenencia de Rodrigo a cambio de la galería que le pertenece a ella por ser una herencia familiar. Marilyn se imagina a Ricardo como un hombre perfecto. Valentina habla con Efraín y le cuenta que estuvo a punto de decirle toda la verdad a Julieta pero que llego Ana Belén y no lo pudo hacer.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardo intenta rescatar a Ricardito mientras enfrenta la enfermedad de Elizabeth, quien necesita una biopsia medular. Katiuska es descubierta visitando a una bruja y abandona la casa de los Tariffi tras ser confrontada. En paralelo, Marcelo y Graciela se divorcian, mientras María del Pilar celebra el suceso. La policía identifica a Carrero como el secuestrador, y Ricardo se dispone a pagar el rescate personalmente, temiendo por su vida y encargando el cuidado de sus hijos a Manuela.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Humberto descubre en el cuarto de Eustoquio los documentos del Bramón y se los muestra a Isaías, quien corre a contarle a Blanca: son sus tierras. Amalia enfrenta a Rivero por las acusaciones contra Alejandro; Erasto llega y la galantea. Alejandro sorprende a Carlos declarándole a Rosa que se enamora de ella; los expulsa furioso. Andreína se casa con Robert tras llegar a la iglesia en camioneta. Eustoquio descubre a Consuelo y Blanca buscando los papeles en su apartamento. Erasto invade la recepción y exige a Natalia. Adolfo lo confronta amenazándolo con la policía.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Enzo va a buscar a Milagros a su departamento y en los pasillos se encuentra con Benito, le dice que es vecino de ella y de Luisita… en ese momento se escuchan gritos de Milagros pidiendo auxilio, ya que Artemio Ansola se había desmayado, éste había entrado a la casa de Olga para decirle toda la verdad sobre la hija perdida de Clemencia Talamonti. Enzo y Milagros lo llevan al hospital, donde descubren que Artemio es el esposo de Eulalia, entonces Enzo y Milagros tratan de hablar con Eulalia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Venancio encuentra a Lázara con Pablo Barranco y éste como es de esperar le hace un escándalo por celos. Sin darse cuenta que Carlos Enrique es testigo de este escándalo escucha toda la discusión de Venancio y Lázara. Allí Carlos Enrique escucha de un tal Pablo y empieza a tener un ataque de celos por Lázara, lo cual lo confunde porque debería estar celoso de su esposa Nancy, pero lejos de ello se enceguece y le pide explicaciones a Lázara sobre Pablo. Cuando Lázara creía que era imposible el romance con Carlos Enrique era imposible por estar casado, éste se presenta pidiéndole explicaciones del tal Pablo. Allí ella se da cuenta que no es ella sola quien está enamorada

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras un año de separación y sintiéndose alertada del regreso de Armando a Venezuela Finita visita su casa al buscar retomar su antiguo romance ahora avalada con el derecho de ser una mujer divorciada | Finita observa con horror la realización de su mas nefasta pesadilla al encontrarse con Natalia quien se presenta ante ella como la novia de Armando. en el local de persianas Botero se autocompadece de su situación como hombre y empleador tras haber perdido a Wilker como su empleado.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia promete renunciar a su venganza por su amor a Augusto. Augusto se siente culpable de haberla engañado con María Gracia y espera que su historia con ella termine así de rápido como empezó. Artemio Ansola está internado en el hospital que trabaja Augusto, en grave estado debido a la enfermedad que padece. Artemio sabe que pronto va a morir y no quiere llevarse consigo un gran secreto. Él sabe que fue lo que pasó con la hija perdida de Clemencia.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Sin tanto clamor ni culpa, Guillermo busca la excusa perfecta para dejar a Yenny un día antes del gran acontecimiento que significa la boda entre Ana y Cristóbal. Guillermo encontró un perrito abandonado en la autopista, y cuando quiso ingresarlo a su apartamento, Yenny le pidió que se lo llevara a otra parte. Un pequeño e inocuo motivo, pero la gran salvedad para Guillermo que sin sentir un ápice de pena, abandona a Yenny, dejándola sola con su pequeña hija. Y es que esta noticia debe contársela con urgencia a Ana, ya que aún conserva una última esperanza en que ese matrimonio no llegue a concretarse.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Tras una intensa interpretación de sus personajes en la trama de la película de Junior Graciela y Atanasio se reconcilian llevando así a la realidad sus sentimientos tras hacer pareja juntos en la filmación. En el centro comercial Briggite y Gisela se encuentran para rivalizar una ves mas haciendo alarde de las ofensas que las llevan a herirse la una a la otra | Briggite aprovecha la ocasión para insistir ante Gisela del supuesto y romántico interés que Atanasio siente por ella.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Brenda le pide a Gabriel si se puede quedar con el niño para que ella pueda salir y tener una vida propia. Gabriel le propone contratar una niñera o una guardería porque él no tiene tiempo. Magdalena escucha que Angie y Gabriel se van de segunda luna de miel. Epi beso a Valentina, pero ella no entiende nada porque cree que él es gay. Nayarí le explica al barrio que el Capitán no es ningún santo como creen todos, que fue un buen hombre pero que no hace milagros. Gabriel va a cuidar al bebe junto a Epi para que Brenda pueda tener su cita con Ricardo. Marilyn llama a Angie para contarle que Gabriel tiene un hijo con Brenda.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Ricardito aparece sano y salvo luego de que Candelaria lo dejara en una iglesia, donde Elizabeth lo encuentra tras pedir un milagro. Ricardo descubre que Elizabeth está gravemente enferma y corre riesgo de morir, una verdad que usa para suplicarle a Manuela que no lo abandone. Mientras tanto, Katiuska asesina a Carrero y queda desconcertada por el intento de rescate fallido. A pesar de la alegría por el regreso del niño, la tragedia médica de Elizabeth marca el destino de la familia.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Erasto se lleva a Natalia de la fiesta y la golpea obligándola a arrodillarse. Le habla como si fuera Consuelo. Eustoquio confiesa a Isaías su infancia traumática jurando venganza contra todos. Robert y Andreína celebran sentando bases del matrimonio. Junior discute con Rosa porque ella se niega a dormir con él. Rosalía visita a Erasto y le revela los planes de Alejandro sobre las tierras. Eustoquio se niega a entregar los documentos a Blanca, prefiriendo extorsionar a Erasto. Rosa anuncia que irá a hablar con su madre Carmen Rosa para que se mude con ellos.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Clemencia va al hospital a ver a Artemio para preguntarle sobre el paradero de su hija. Artemio se encuentra en muy mal estado de salud pero puede decirle algo, le alcanza a decir que había sido él quien le había quitado a su hija en la creencia de que Clemencia había muerto y la había llevado con Olga Valdez pero luego trata de hablar y no puede más y muere. Clemencia se queda angustiada porque Olga Valdez está en cama y no puede hablar ni moverse.

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: Ana sigue en duda de casarse con Cristóbal o salir corriendo a buscar a Guillermo para decirle cuanto lo ama. Guillermo le dice a Pedro que no cree que sea Ana la que le contesto el mensaje de texto, ya que ella es muy comprensiva y está enamorada de él. Marilda quiere tratar de convencer a sus hijos para que no vayan a la boda y así ella no se queda sola en la casa. Pedro es el complica de Cristóbal para separar a Ana de Guillermo y evitar que se junten y se den cuenta que se aman y que Guillermo dejo a Yenny. Carlos Enrique quiere reconquistar a su mujer pero lo que siente por Lazara es más fuerte y no lo puede controlar.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: En la cancha de basquet Yubiri se reúne con Wilker para fijarle a este su posición al sentirse desplazada en su vida por sus admiradoras y su carrera | Yubiri siguiendo el consejo de Briggite y Bienvenida que la obligan a buscar su felicidad le plantea a Wilker el termino de su noviazgo a pesar de amarlo | Wilker sintiéndose temeroso de llegar a perder el amor de Yubiri le hace a esta la promesa de cambiar muy a pesar de su fama para continuar teniéndola como novia.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Angie no le cree a su marido que tenga un hijo con Brenda. Magdalena se asegura que Sofía le salga de testigo en su juicio de divorcio pero lo que no sabe es que ella está en la cama junto a Agustín, planeando perjudicarla. programme.title: Eva Braun
programme.desc: Fue solo después de su muerte que Eva Braun saltó a la fama en Alemania. Junto con Adolf Hitler, el 30 de abril de 1945 se quitó la vida en el búnker bajo la Cancillería del Reich en Berlín. El día anterior, el dictador se había casado con Braun, su amante durante muchos años. Apartada del mundo, Eva Braun pasó la mayor parte del tiempo en Múnich o en la residencia Berghof de Hitler en los Alpes. Después de la guerra, Albert Speer, antiguo arquitecto de Adolf Hitler, describió a Braun como una de las "decepciones de la historia". La primera biografía científica de Heike Görtmaker busca revisar la imagen de la rubia y apolítica figura al lado del Führer.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.desc: Olga confiesa que no ama a Alcides ni quiere casarse. Alejandro decide olvidar a Alicia y buscar a Reina. Eduardo excava en la finca de Alcira y sigue hallando esmeraldas. Esmeralda descubre que su padre negocia con el Zarco Gutiérrez, junto a Gladys lo enfrenta por esos tratos, desatando tensiones familiares y conflictos en la región.

programme.title: Poco Más de Un Año
programme.desc: Después de caerse del techo en una fiesta de Año Nuevo, Owen decide que es hora de hacer algunos cambios radicales en su vida. Durante el año siguiente, deja de beber, vuelve a entrar en la vida de su hijo del que estaba separado, reaviva viejas amistades, se enamora... y pronto descubre que a veces en la vida sólo se necesita un pequeño cambio.

programme.title: Plus One at an Amish Wedding
programme.desc: La prometedora doctora superestrella April tiene la vida perfecta. Trabaja en un prestigioso hospital de Nueva York y recientemente conoció a un apuesto veterinario llamado Jesse.

programme.title: La Cacería: En el fin del mundo
programme.desc: La pesadilla comienza cuando José Mirkovic, un adolescente solitario y alumno de un colegio de curas, desaparece tras una noche de fiesta. Ante la indiferencia policial y el silencio de la Iglesia, su madre, Susana Rivera, inicia una cruzada para descubrir la verdad. Tras semanas sin respuestas, aparece un extraño que ofrece esperanza: César Rojas, ex policía convertido en investigador privado, marcado por un pasado turbulento. Junto a la joven oficial Antonia Loij, Rojas sigue el rastro del enigmático padre Correa, ex director del colegio de José, quien parece esconder más de un secreto. Mientras Susana y Rojas luchan por resolver el caso y descubrir qué le sucedió a José, en Santiago el capitán Rodrigo Carrasco, antiguo compañero de Rojas en la policía, recibe una alerta sobre el caso. En las sombras, una red de encubrimientos comienza a cerrarse, mientras crece el temor de que este y otros crímenes enterrados salgan a la luz.

programme.desc: Después de una mala crítica de un crítico y una charla del chef Gordon Ramsay, un chef londinense talentoso pero afligido convierte un pub rural en un restaurante gourmet. programme.title: El Tercer Reich en Color
programme.desc: Las imágenes del Tercer Reich en la memoria de generaciones siempre se conservan en blanco y negro. Pero ocultas en archivos fílmicos y colecciones privadas, también se han conservado imágenes completamente diferentes, en color. Tomadas en las playas de Normandía y en sencillos festivales folclóricos, documentan las atrocidades de la Wehrmacht durante la guerra y la vida en la granja de montaña de Hitler, y aportan una realidad opresiva a las imágenes del criminal régimen nazi.

programme.desc: Una estrella de telerrealidad deja L. A. y se dirige a territorio Amish, donde descubrirá una nueva realidad.

programme.title: Una sorpresa real
programme.desc: Cuando el novio de Riley, Mandla, la invita a Sudáfrica para conocer a su familia, ella se sorprende al descubrir que él es un príncipe. La noticia pone en peligro la confianza de Riley en Mandla.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Lucía se besa con Melo delante de todos a pesar de la prohibición de su padre. Esa misma noche, Esmeralda escapa de la casa. Por otra parte, Alejandro le confiesa al Alcalde que está enamorado de Reina, mientras el pueblo es acosado por maleantes que destruyen todo a su paso.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Cuando ortega se entera que su prima sale con Alejandro, se enfurece. Ese día, cuando los maleantes se meten a la finca de Alcides, los campesinos se defienden y hieren a la novia del Zarco. Mientras tanto, Olga continúa empeñada en no casarse y en conquistar al Padre Javier.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo le pide a Esmeralda que sean novios, obviamente al estar enamorada de Ricardo lo rechaza, días después de haber hecho una denuncia radial de la situación en la Victoria, el reportero amigo de Alejandro es asesinado. Por esos días, Eduardo engaña a Alcira, quedándose con todo lo que le pertenecía.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Ortega pierde las licitaciones y Eduardo lo obliga a dejar la casa con su hija, luego roba y desaparece a Alcira. Más tarde, los Guerrero sufren una explosión en la mina que los deja atrapados. Tras horas de esfuerzo, Alejandro, Ricardo y Alcides son rescatados, dejando a Ortega frustrado por no lograr matarlos.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: El segundo derrumbe atrapa la pierna de Alcides. Esa noche Reina confronta a Ortega, quien la amenaza de muerte. Eduardo se une a uno de los caciques de la zona para acabar con Ortega y con el Zarco, logrando someterlos y capturarlos. Días después, Olga termina por comprometerse con Alcides cuando él queda en silla de ruedas.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo obliga a Esmeralda a comprometerse. Alcira regresa para denunciarlo y recuperar sus tierras, lo que divide a la familia tras enfrentarlo Alejandro y Ricardo. Días después, Olga se casa con Alcides y Esmeralda con Eduardo, quien ordena asesinar a Ortega a manos de “El Tigre” y “El Cascabel”.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Finalmente, Eduardo es culpado por varios crímenes, pero su hermano Ricardo logra detenerlo antes de que sea atrapado por la Policía. Tras 20 años de cárcel, Eduardo cumple su condena y es liberado.

programme.title: Esmeraldas
programme.desc: Eduardo rechaza a toda su familia, haciendo alianzas políticas para quitarle las minas a su papá y hermanos, Esmeralda se encuentra con Ricardo, a pesar de que él no la ha olvidado, ella lo rechaza pues no pretende volver al estar apurada intentando sacar a su hijo de la Victoria. Más adelante, Eduardo se encuentra con Esmeralda cuando a él le hacen un atentado.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: Lo que parece ser un trabajo rutinario de control de plagas se convierte en una pesadilla al estilo de los 'Gremlins' mientras Astro y el equipo intentan derrotar a un ejército creciente de ratas fuera de control que ha descendido sobre un centro comercial. Lo que empeora las cosas es que la clave de por qué las ratas se han vuelto tan locas no se puede ver ni tocar, ¡solo se puede oler!

programme.title: Laberinto de Sombras
programme.desc: Elena quedó ciega tras un accidente, y vive sola en una vieja casa familiar. Con la llegada de dos extraños que pretenden robarle sus joyas y la aparición de extrañas fuerzas sobrenaturales convertirán la casa en un peligroso laberinto.

programme.title: El Devorador de Huesos
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo comienza a excavar en el desierto, la policía local se enfrenta a una serie de macabros asesinatos. En estos extraños crímenes, las víctimas han sido despojadas de sus huesos mediante un método que ni siquiera la comunidad médica logra explicar. Sin saberlo, el equipo ha desatado a un antiguo espíritu indígena —el Devorador de Huesos— que busca vengarse.

programme.title: Go Astro Boy Go!
programme.desc: El profesor Elefun y el Dr. Blunt están enfrascados en una batalla por un concurso para ver quién puede aterrizar un huevo de forma segura tras soltarlo, utilizando la resistencia del viento. La competición se ve interrumpida por una llamada de auxilio del aeropuerto de Pekín, donde la jefa de control de tráfico aéreo, Maylin, intenta en vano arreglar el sistema de comunicaciones. Suzu restablece el contacto por radio con los dos últimos aviones que deben aterrizar, y el primero desciende sano y salvo con la ayuda de uno de los artilugios de Astro Kitty. Pero a medida que la tormenta de granizo se intensifica, los granizos dañan los motores del último avión, haciendo que los pilotos pierdan el control. ¡Parece que el avión se estrellará en el centro de Pekín! En una tensa misión a gran velocidad, Astro utiliza una carpa gigante como paracaídas para frenar el avión, mientras Astro Kitty lo estabiliza. Juntos, el Equipo Astro aterriza el avión de forma segura, llevando la misión a un final de infarto.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: An family farm in the mid-west contains houses, barns, outbuildings, trailers, grain silos and buses full of old stuff and perhaps the biggest stash of undiscovered old motorcycles in the country. The collection was put together by their unnamed father. Seller agrees to have Dale broker rare Excelsior for high-end client. Dale has the buyer, but will he outbid his own client for the exclusive find?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Matt is out for revenge. Last year Dale beat him badly at the Annual Vintage bike race in Barber, Alabama. But this year there is a whole new tale to tell. With just days until the race - Dale is secretly struggling to get the bike he beat Matt with last year up and working. Matt struggles just to locate a 100-year old bike. Matt's prayers are answered thanks to an old Catholic Priest he located who has possession of a bike. The priest might let Matt have the bike to race - but there are conditions. The toughest one: Don't tell Dale you have it. Can Matt afford to buy the bike and get it running in time for the race without Dale seeing it? Will Dale even get his broken bike started? And if they ever get to race, will Matt exact his revenge?

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Built in the mid-60’s by eccentric engineer “Wild Bill” Gelbke, the Road Dog was, and still is, the largest motorcycle ever built. It utilized aircraft tubing, Corvette disc brakes, and a Chevy truck differential to keep it stable. The one-off creation disappeared when Gelbke did in 1978. Outflanked once when the bike was spotted and sold to a private collector in 1995, Dale has vowed to locate the machine and make Wheels Through Time its final resting place.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Dale searches for priceless motorcycles to bring to the Vegas auction.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The RM Auction Company has worked with Dale before as a buyer, seller, historian, and caretaker at the prestigious Lee Hartung auction. But this event is no last minute rush to define one man’s treasures. This is a well calculated, time consuming, multi-media, and multi motorcycle and prized art deal.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: The Senior Vice President at Home Depot, Gordon Erickson at is a huge fan of Wheels Through Time. He is also a huge supporter of the Wounded Warrior program. For years the hard-ware giant has been donating goods and services to help returning servicemen with their fix-it-up projects. Now they would like to go one step further and build a WWII military bike to raise awareness and funds. Only problem is where to get one? Enter Dale and an exhaustive, time sensitive, cross country search for a rare military machine.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: Promoters of the prestigious Amelia Island Concourse have called on Dale to develop a show and field bikes for an “Orphan Bike” show. They have defined orphan bike as extremely rare, non Harley or Indian machines.

programme.title: What's in the Barn
programme.desc: For Dale and Matt sometimes the dotted line to treasure splits and heads in opposite directions. In this edition of What’s in the Barn, time is thrust to the forefront of this multi-state, long distance, north, south search. Timeless and priceless 110 year old bikes, antique cars, airplanes, and the infamous Egberts 1930 neon Harley-Davidson sign that coined the phrase “Ride a Winner” are high on this father and son’s list of “must haves”. The clock ticks, both literally and figuratively, on one rare time piece and two old-timer’s cars, bikes, and automobiles.

programme.title: Caffeine & Octane
programme.desc: The word is out that Caffeine & Octane is the ultimate scene and the place to be seen. Even after 12 hours of racing at the Petit Le Mans endurance race, Henry Ford III, the great grandson of Henry Ford the industrial magnate and current member of Ford’s Board of Directors, showed up to take in the sights, address the crowds, and sign a one of a kind Ford Shelby GT350R. The GT350R will hit the road with Operation Hope to encourage young people to study math and science through motorsports; Covert car counterfeiter, Chuck Beck looks for Ford’s approval on his own version of a muscled up Festiva. YouTuber ‘That Dude in Blue’ David Patterson joins Skip and Bryan to get a special look at the motor-based philanthropic outreach and amazing cars that come with it done by John Hope Bryant, friend of Caffeine and Octane.

programme.title: Har Dil Jo Pyar Karega…
programme.desc: Jahnvi’s best friend Pooja attempts suicide when her boyfriend jilts her. Raj, a struggling singer, saves Pooja but she still goes into a coma and Raj gets stuck into caring for her. Upon recovery, Pooja falls for Raj, but he is in love with Jahnvi.

programme.title: Maine Dil Tujhko Diya
programme.desc: College stud and a famed band player Ajay is introduced to the stunning daughter of a business tycoon named Ayesha. Ajay is smitten by Ayesha's modesty and coyness and what starts off as a mere acquaintance soon turns into full-blown love affair. But Ayesha's father Mr. Verma is unhappy with their union and his associate Mr. Chopra takes advantage of his discontentment. Mr. Chopra, wanting to take over Mr. Verma's fortune, suggests his own son for Ayesha and brainwashes him about Ajay. The situation takes a deadly turn when a hit-man is appointed to end Ajay's life. But seeing Ajay's aggressive stubbornness to be with Ayesha, Mr. Verma gives him a challenge, to find his lady-love within a day or leave from her life forever. Ajay accepts the challenge, unaware that a bigger conspiracy is at work to tear them apart once and for all.

programme.title: Anupama
programme.desc: A successful businessman becomes an alcoholic after his wife dies during childbirth. He blames his daughter Uma for the tragedy. Introverted Uma grows up all by herself and falls for a poet, who slowly brings her out of her shell.

programme.title: Sachai Ki Taqat
programme.desc: When Ram Singh, a noble police officer, learns that the man whom he imprisoned is in fact innocent and has been played by the culprits who murdered his father, he goes on a mission to help him.

programme.title: Devar
programme.desc: Childhood sweethearts Shankar and Banwariya get separated after she moves out of town. Years later Shankar sets on a self-destructive path after learning that Banwariya is now married to his cousin.

programme.title: Jaisi Karni Waisi Bharni
programme.desc: After swindling his parents of their ancestral home, Vijay sets them astray. Years later, upon learning the truth, his own son plots to teach Vijay and his wife a lesson.

programme.title: Raja Hindustani
programme.desc: A young taxi driver and a rich city girl fall head over heels in love with each other. Defying her family, she marries him and relocates to his village. But her family weaves a web of deception to split them apart.

programme.title: Golmaal: Fun Unlimited
programme.desc: The story revolves around the lives of four guys named Gopal, Lucky, Madhav, and Laxman who all absurdly fall for the same girl. Hence, begins the hilarious race to win her heart.

programme.title: Ekka Raja Rani
programme.desc: An ace Kathak dancer, Barkha (Ayesha Jhulka) saves the life of a feared underworld don, Vishal (Vinod Khanna) and suffers minor injuries. Vishal brings her into his lavish house and makes sure that she's well taken care of. In the same house, she meets Vishal's arrogant brother, Sagar (Govinda) who gets annoyed by her presence. But they get over their initial dislike of each other and fall in love. Problem arises when Vishal too begins to like Barkha and plans to marry her. How will he react when he finds out the truth?

programme.title: Deewaar: Let's Bring Our Heroes Home
programme.desc: A group of Indian POW (Prisoners of War) from the 1971 Indo-Pak war rebels against the Pakistani army and tries to escape from their captivity. Helping the group in the mission is Gaurav, the son of a former Army Major also held captive by the enemy.

programme.title: Ghulam-E-Mustafa
programme.desc: Mustafa goes to live with a family who refuses to sell their house to his employer. Little does he know that this is going to change his life forever.

programme.title: Sharafat Gayi Tel Lene
programme.desc: A geeky commoner Prithvi Khurana (Zayed Khan) is content with his mediocre job and steady girlfriend. But when his account mysteriously gets credited with 1 million rupees he seeks the help of his philandering slacker roommate Sam (Rannvijay Singh) to solve the mystery.

programme.title: Jab We Met

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela se agota en el recorrido por la selva pantanosa, Juan dice que no va a continuar sin ella. Dínora dispara al aire y esto lo escuchan Franco y Óscar, que van tras esa pista.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora admite que están perdidos, no los ha guiado bien, le jura a Fernando que pase lo que pase, Juan no sale con vida, entrada la noche, un animal pica a Dínora. Rosario despierta del coma.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Fernando se cansa de cargar a Dínora en una camilla improvisada y propone continuar sin ella. Eva decide ayudar a Benito y se asocia con él para crear una fábrica de hamburguesas.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Dínora se aferra a Juan como su última salvación, desesperada ataca a Fernando, quien le dispara y ve cómo el cuerpo de ella se pierde en el pantano. Rosario se disculpa con Franco y Sara.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Aníbal, el tío de los Reyes, se encarga de organizar la expedición de rescate, lo acompañan Franco, Óscar y la policía. A Juan se le agudiza el dolor de la pierna y Fernando se va por su lado.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan y Gabriela se cuentan sus historias familiares y él menciona al tío Aníbal, a quien estaban buscando al llegar a la región, pero no lo hallaron y por eso pasaron mucho trabajo en el pueblo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: La cuadrilla continúa buscando, Juan y Gabriela los escuchan y tienen esperanzas de sobrevivir. Fernando reaparece cuando ellos encuentran una salida y los amenaza, pero cae en el lodo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan y Gabriela son rescatados, él no esconde la alegría cuando ve a sus hermanos y finalmente se reencuentra con Norma, Gabriela está muy débil, es hospitalizada. Eva y Aníbal se reconocen.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Gabriela le pide perdón a sus hijas y a su padre, quiere un nuevo comienzo, a su salida del hospital, su familia le prepara una fiesta sorpresa. Franco y Sara se casan, finalmente reina la paz.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Bernardo Elizondo, un hacendado mayor y adinerado, se enamora de Libia, una joven humilde que enfrenta la furia de sus hermanos porque ella es vista como una prostituta por la gente del pueblo.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Juan quiere marcharse lejos con sus hermanos para que Libia se olvide de ese amor, pero una verdad golpea el honor de la familia Reyes, mientras Bernardo esconde que es un hombre casado.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la muerte y el engaño de Elizondo, Libia va a la hacienda, se siente desamparada y no aguanta más al ser fuertemente humillada por Gabriela, la viuda de Bernardo, y sus hijas.

programme.title: Pasión de gavilanes

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: Rookie Robot

programme.desc: It’s been 60 years since AA was introduced to the shooting sports world. Professional and recreational shooters alike have trusted AA for six decades. In this episode, load up for stories of high school, collegiate competitors and the world’s best as they bust clays with the legendary shot shell. - GUESTS: Zach Keenbaum (Team Winchester) Desi Edmunds (Team Winchester) Kayla Wilgus (Team Winchester) Amy Cawley (Team Winchester) Anthony Matarese (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life

Watch as Winchester’s best shooters vie for Gold as they compete against over 2,500 shooters and 17 countries. We’ll also join the Kids and Clays foundation in Florida as they host an event that will most certainly touch your soul.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Across the country, deer season to many Americans is a rite of passage. For generations, Winchester has been the trusted ammunition choice for hunters…and it’s been a decade since the game-changing Deer Season XP whitetail line was introduced. In this episode, we’ll celebrate the many successes by Team Winchester hunters in the field during whitetail and mule deer firearm seasons across the United States. - GUESTS: Melissa Bachman (Team Winchester) Mark Drury (Team Winchester) Nikki Boxler (Team Winchester) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester) Jason Gilbertson (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The mission of Shoot United is to be a content resource for millions of shooters and a place where people can learn, build confidence and find ways to participate. Through films, educational videos and articles, SU has impacted countless shooters all over the world. In this episode, join Shoot United Ambassadors as they inspire and educate through a series of instructional videos and stories in pistol, self-defense, trap and skeet and sporting clays. - GUESTS: Thea Van Sync (Team Winchester) Callie Farill (Team Winchester) Becky Yackley (Team Winchester) Theo Ribbs (Team Winchester) Jessica Hook (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.desc: The bond between and parent and child can grow in many ways, but nothing compares to the bond shared when hunting. programme.title: Local Knowledge

Joining locals Jimmy Hendrix and Jordi Hortensi, the game plan is simple: check in by boat, chase fish, eat well, and go dive. From kite fishing the reef to fresh seafood and great company, this episode is all about experiencing the true rhythm of a Florida Keys vacation.

programme.title: Road Trip Angler
programme.desc: In this episode of Road Trip Angler, host Jameson Redding takes guests Jesse Laspeyre and Brooks Beatty on a multi-day adventure exploring the Forgotten Coast along the Florida Adventure Trail, chasing fish and adventure at every turn.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: Experience the magic of shore diving from one of the Keys’ most scenic beaches. The episode also follows military veterans discovering healing and renewed purpose through diving.

programme.title: Dirt
programme.desc: New. York. City. That’s where our host Josh Rosen kicks off his journey in Episode 4—and where he lived for 16 years and started up the surf-centric apparel brand, Saturdays NYC. Back in his old stomping grounds, Josh first meets up with the award-winning chef and Mumbai native, Chintan Pandya, currently blowing up the New York food scene with his unapologetic and authentic Indian cuisine (pro tip: try the goat brains). Next, Josh travels through the boroughs, heads upstate, and along the coast to source local ingredients—from sake brewers and pig farmers to catching fresh lobster just 100 miles from Wall Street. As always the adventure will end with a feast, right back in Chintan’s kitchen.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: In the heart of the Zambezi Delta, a team of conservationists have overseen one of the largest range expansions of African lions in modern times. From a reintroduction of 24 lions in 2018, today the population is more than a hundred.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff wade into the flooded timber of the legendary Coca-Cola Woods, where mallards drop through the treetops in waves. Amidst echoes of calling and wingbeats, they experience one of America’s most iconic duck hunts.

programme.title: Destination Dive
programme.desc: In this episode, we will highlight what’s being done in the Florida Keys to protect and save the reefs. We will show innovative solutions researchers have created to protect the coral and showcase the recovery that’s taking place.

programme.title: Stomping Grounds
programme.desc: From battling towering 12-foot waves in the Gulf of Alaska, to reeling in colossal 200 lb. halibut, they discover firsthand the rugged beauty of America's 49th state. This episode highlights Lindell Yachts as a top builder of rugged offshore sportfishing yachts, as well as Radon Boats as great pilothouse fishing and guide boats.

programme.title: Fox Hollow Outdoors
programme.desc: Michael continues the family tradition of fish stew and gathering, with hopes that Larkin will pass on the same traditions.

programme.title: Goin' Coastal
programme.desc: As the pressure of opening his new store builds, Josh steps away from the chaos and returns to the water for a solo wade fishing trip — his first in years.

programme.title: Canadian Whitetail
programme.desc: With few mature bucks to hunt Dean heads out to put his time in regardless because anything, can happen.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The team at Winchester Ammunition has arrived in Oregon to visit the Leupold Long Range Academy. There, they’ll put Winchester’s new “Supreme Long Range” ammunition to the test, pushing its performance across demanding long-range scenarios. - - With precision, consistency, and confidence on the line, the team is eager to demonstrate exactly what “Precision Rifle Perfected” means when every shot counts.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Join Benny Spies of Team Winchester as he shares stories of his upbringing in South Dakota. From cherished family photos to duck seasons of the past, learn how a passion for hunting was ignited and became a way of life for Benny and his family.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: In this episode of The Wilderness Chronicles, we uncover true accounts from around the world that feel almost impossible. A fisherman off the coast of Chile is taken by a breaching whale. A diver vanishes into darkness and finds himself trapped inside the mouth of a humpback whale. Two kayakers are lifted from the water by something massive lurking just below the surface of the ocean. - These are not legends. These are real people telling their stories. - We also revisit one of the most powerful moments in the Bible. The story of Jonah. Scripture tells us that God prepared a great fish to swallow Jonah for a divine purpose. Could something like that still happen today? What does science say about surviving inside a whale? And are these modern encounters more than just coincidence?

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: The movie Jaws was inspired by a string of shark attacks... some in FRESHWATER! In this eerie episode of Wilderness Chronicles, Kyle Green explores the shocking reality of sharks found in freshwater. From bull sharks traveling up the Mississippi River to strange reports out of the Great Lakes, we examine how far these predators can really go. You'll hear about bull sharks in Lake Nicaragua, the science behind their survival in rivers and lakes, and theories about whether they could adapt to colder waters. It's a mix of strange history, biology, and firsthand accounts that might make you think twice before jumping in.

programme.title: Wilderness Chronicles
programme.desc: Deep in the backroads of the Midwest there are stories locals rarely tell out loud. Stories of pale figures with oversized heads watching from the trees. Stories passed down in whispers and warnings. The Melon Heads legend has haunted Michigan, Ohio, and surrounding states for decades. Some say they are the result of dark experiments. Others believe they are something far older. Something that never left the woods.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff hear about the dangers of fishing for Bluefin Tuna in the Atlantic Ocean from locals in Gloucester, Massachusetts. Then they head 30 miles out onto the open ocean with Darrin of Reel Respect Charters in the hopes of landing their own giant.

programme.title: The Green Way Outdoors
programme.desc: Kyle and Jeff team up with their friends from Boss Shotshells in South Dakota for a high-energy upland hunt, pursuing wild pheasants with the help of skilled hunting dogs. The adventure takes a quirky turn with a visit to the iconic Corn Palace.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: After harvesting a tough Anatolian Chamois, Mark Peterson heads south to the Taurus Mountains for his next challenge: The Bezoar Ibex. With the pre-rut in full swing, most Ibex are in small bachelor groups. It's only a matter of time before Mark spots a mature trophy—requiring skill, patience, and a solid understanding of this rugged terrain.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson returns to the stunning island of Dugi Otok in Croatia for his third time in pursuit of a Kri Kri ibex. This Mediterranean gem offers a true sportsman's paradise, home to an incredible variety of huntable species. While the island presents opportunities for Axis Deer and other game—which Mark briefly glasses during his adventure—the primary focus remains on connecting with a quality Kri Kri Ibex. Join Mark as he navigates the familiar yet ever-challenging terrain of Dugi Otok.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Follow along with Mark Peterson as he heads north to Nunavut within the Arctic Circle. On this trip, he has brought along his Gunwerks muzzleloader as well as his Gunwerks rifle. With two Caribou tags and a Musk Ox tag in his pocket, he’s excited to put both firearms to use. The muzzleloader is up to bat first. With the rocky, wide open tundra terrain it makes it more of a challenge to get close enough with the muzzleloader.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: This week is all about Woody, a fearless Jack Russle who spends his free time doing everything from Black Bear hunting in Vancouver to Sheep hunting in the mountains.

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson has one more tag in his pocket after harvesting both a Central Barren Ground Caribou and a Muskox with his Gunwerks muzzleloader on day one. This time, he has his Gunwerks rifle in hand. The conditions have been perfect, but there is a front pushing in with a ton of rain coming so Mark is eager to fill his final tag before the bad weather hits. Spotting a large group of Caribou with one big one mixed in early on in the day, he is hoping to have success and end his trip to Nunavut off with a bang!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.desc: Mark Peterson heads out on a unique hunt for the rare Anatolian Chamois, a mountain dweller found in the high elevations of northern Turkey. With a storm rolling in, Mark hopes the weather will push the Chamois down from their usual heights, giving him a rare chance to track this prey across the challenging landscape.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: Some mornings just remind you why we do this. We found ourselves in Southwest Alabama on one of the prettiest mornings a turkey hunter could ever ask for — cool air, soft light breaking through the timber, and gobbles echoing through the hardwoods. Even better, we got to share it with a great friend, and that’s what makes hunts like this truly special. This is what turkey hunting is all about — good friends, beautiful mornings, and chasing longbeards in God’s country.

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: This Kentucky trip is one we’ll be talking about for a long time. Three longbeards hit the ground, but honestly, it’s the time spent in the woods with good friends that made this hunt what it was. We had birds gobbling, lots of laughs, and a memories that will last a lifetime, and that’s what makes turkey hunting so addicting. These are the kind of hunts you don’t take for granted.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: FishON! | "Trophy Walleye Adventure on Pierre Lake"
programme.desc: Join us as we kick off Season 7 with an unforgettable adventure north of Cochrane, Ontario, on the pristine waters of Pierre Lake. We team up with Mark Froud from Dunn Right Outfitters, an expert in Northern Ontario fishing, to target trophy walleye. Experience the thrill of reeling in massive catches while surrounded by breathtaking wilderness, and gain valuable tips and insights from Mark to enhance your own fishing techniques. This episode sets the tone for a season filled with excitement, exploration, and exceptional angling.

programme.title: Remote Lakes, Big Fish, Epic Days
programme.desc: Season 8 Episode 3 kicks off our first open-water shoot of the year as Paul Ethier and Jeff Shippam make their way to the legendary Mattagami Lake for some classic spring walleye action. With competitive tournaments on pause this season, the guys revisit their favourite early-season hotspots—areas they’d normally fish under pressure—now with time to explore, adapt, and enjoy the day. From structure-hopping to dialing in the spring pattern, Paul and Jeff put their tournament instincts to work for a fun, relaxed day chasing hungry post-spawn walleye in Northern Ontario.

programme.desc: Join us as we head to Frederick House Lake in Connaught, Ontario, just east of Timmins. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Hero’s Fall
programme.desc: With his deck on the line, Yuya looks to rock the cell block and KO the Kingpin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Yuya is determined to do the impossible and escape from The Facility, but when friends become foes his plan to break out, breaks down!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Fight for Freedom
programme.desc: When Yuya and his pals try to flee The Facility, their big breakout takes a terrible turn when their escape route leads them straight into the security guards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Match with the Master
programme.desc: The opening ceremonies of the Friendship Cup kick into overdrive as Yuya squares off against the Master of Faster - Jack Atlas!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Traits of a Traitor
programme.desc: With the Friendship Cup about to kick off, Yuya learns about tournament champion Jack’s rise to the Tops!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Crow’s Crew
programme.desc: The first duel of the Friendship Cup has the green light as Crow and Gong put the pedal to the metal!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Riley’s Reveal
programme.desc: Riley’s been chosen to Turbo Duel Shinji, but the battle hits a speedbump when Yuya steps in to stop the duel and keep his pint-sized pal in one piece!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Common Cause
programme.desc: For Shinji to inspire the Commons to stand up to the Topsiders, he must first take down Moon Shadow! Can Shinji’s monsters swarm together and deliver the sting of defeat, or will Moon Shadow’s ninjas silence all the buzz?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: A Concerted Effort
programme.desc: Yuya’s friends are forced to face off in a duel where the loser is banished forever! No matter who wins, Yuya loses!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: The Gift of Grit
programme.desc: As the Friendship Cup picks up the pace, Jack Atlas takes a timeout to reveal the secrets of his past!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Duel Consequences
programme.desc: Officer 227 is in hot pursuit to take Yuya down - all the way down to the underground! Can Yuya outrun the long arm of the law, or does 227 have his number?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Turbotainers
programme.desc: Sylvio finally takes center stage at the Friendship Cup, but will he crash and burn under the spotlight?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Turning Point
programme.desc: An escapee from the underground brings word to Yuya on how to take control of the Friendship Cup!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: A Traitor Unmasked
programme.desc: Shay’s duel with Dennis turns into a battle of wits when he tries to force Dennis to reveal his dark secret.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Shay’s Revenge
programme.desc: After finding out that Dennis is from the Fusion Dimension, Shay sets his sights on getting revenge!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Plans of Attack
programme.desc: Yuya and Roget reflect on their pasts to make plans for the future!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: A Con's Game
programme.desc: Zuzu goes deck-to-deck against Sergey – an ex-con who’s looking to “X” out the competition!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Rebel Road
programme.desc: Zuzu’s been hurt, but Yuya can’t race to her rescue until he defeats Shinji first!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Road to Rebellion
programme.desc: Shinji’s Battlewasps are stinging Yuya to submission! But does Yuya have one last card that will tip the scales in his favor?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! ARC-V: Where the Truth Lies
programme.desc: Yuya’s newest ally is… Roget? Questions are raised that plunge Yuya's reputation into a freefall!
